senses.gloss: h.,אֲלַל ch. m. (b. h. אֱלִל Job XIII, 4; v. אֱלִיל; cmp. הלל) soft, lax object, whence fatty substance, offal of meat. Targ. Job. l. c.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:1">Ḥull. IX, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 121a:3">Ib. 121ᵃ</cite>, diff. of opin. as to what kind of offal is meant in the Mish., v. <cite ref="M02558"><he>מַרְדְּקָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 121a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הא׳ המכונס</he> the offal gathered (as a ball).
Meïl. 7ᵃ א׳ כיון דלית ביה וכ׳ ălal, because there is no substantial value in it.
Zeb. 35ᵃ פיגל בא׳ if one had an inappropriate thought about ălal of fowls (which is fit to eat).
